title: Prefix-Sum Subarray Toolkit
prompt:
Implement `subarray_metric(nums, mode, value) -> int` for an integer sequence. Support exactly these modes:

- `count_target`: return the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals `value`.
- `longest_target`: return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum equals `value`, or `0` when none exists.
- `count_divisible`: return the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by nonzero integer `value`. Treat a negative divisor as its absolute value.

Inputs can contain negative numbers and zeros. Use the zero-prefix seed so subarrays beginning at index `0` are counted correctly. For `longest_target`, retain the earliest index for each prefix sum. Raise `ValueError` for an unknown mode or a zero divisor in `count_divisible` mode.
